symbol_set.description: Stimulus type (default pictures). letters/numbers are generated content and ignore category_key.

category_key.description: Required only when symbol_set is pictures (or absent).

chunk_size.description: Group N symbols per shown/choice item (default 1). Chunking = Extreme difficulty (remember AB, CD as units).

case_mode.description: letters only: upper (default) or mixed upper/lower with visually-similar distractors.

trial_count.description: Rounds per session (additive, default 1). Each round emits its own sequence_display_started/sequence_hidden pair into the shared session log.
